name: Launch screen and animated splash
description: A launch screen declared in Info.plist (background color with dark variant and a logo image) and a SwiftUI splash that animates the same logo into the app.
usage: Wrap the root in the App: `WindowGroup { SplashContainer { RootView() } }`. The system launch screen shows LaunchBackground and LaunchLogo from the asset catalog; SplashContainer continues with the same logo, animates it (respecting Reduce Motion) and fades into the app. It skips itself for -ios-agent-screen launches so screenshots show the real screens.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify launch-screen` on a Mac with Xcode.
